channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Punjab-Origin Influencer Nancy Grewal, 45, Stabbed To Death In Canada; Family Alleges Prior Threats
item.description: A Punjab-origin YouTuber was fatally stabbed in Ontario’s LaSalle, prompting a homicide probe as her family alleges she had received threats earlier.

item.title: Nepal’s Gen Z‑Fueled Historic Election: 19 Million Voters Decide Future After 2025 Protests Against Corruption
item.description: Nepal holds first general election since youth-led protests toppled government, with 19 million voters amid tight security.

item.title: Delhi Court Orders Akasa Air to Pay ₹1.08 Crore to Travel Agent Over 640 Cancelled Seats
item.description: Delhi court orders Akasa Air to pay ₹1.08 crore to travel agent for abruptly cancelling 640 festive season bookings.

item.title: China Halts Diesel and Gasoline Exports Amid Iran’s Hormuz Blockade, Risking 20% Global Oil Supply
item.description: China directed its top refiners to suspend diesel and gasoline exports after Iran effectively closed the Strait of Hormuz, disrupting crude flows through a route that handles roughly 20% of global oil and stoking worries of price spikes and supply chain disruptions

item.title: Navi Mumbai: Hit-and-Run on Palm Beach Road Kills 23-Year-Old Biker, Leaves Teen Critically Injured
item.description: A high-speed, unidentified vehicle rammed a motorcycle on Palm Beach Road, killing the rider and leaving the pillion critically injured.

item.title: US Grants 30-Day Waiver Letting India Import Millions of Barrels of Russian Oil Stranded at Sea
item.description: The waiver allows India to import stranded Russian oil, easing supply crunch amid Middle East tensions.

item.title: President Murmu Orders Big Administrative Shake-Up: Ex-US Envoy Sandhu Becomes Delhi LG, RN Ravi Shifted To Bengal
item.description: Administrative reshuffle across nine regions appoints Taranjit Sandhu Delhi LG, shifts RN Ravi to West Bengal.

item.title: Two IAF Pilots Killed After Su-30MKI Fighter Jet Crashes During Training Mission In Assam Hills
item.description: A routine Indian Air Force training mission turned tragic after a Su-30MKI fighter jet crashed in Assam’s Karbi Anglong, killing both pilots onboard.

item.title: Indore Tragedy: 23-Year-Old Jumps From 5th Floor Apartment After Cop Allegedly Slapped Him
item.description: A 23-year-old Indore resident died after jumping from his apartment building following a late-night encounter with a security guard and police, with his family alleging misconduct while authorities deny assault.

item.title: Delhi Holi Violence: 26-Year-Old Dies After Balloon Splash Dispute Between Families
item.description: A minor balloon splash during Holi allegedly sparked a dispute between two families in Delhi’s Uttam Nagar that escalated into a fatal assault.
